owner_tin_check.name: owner_tin_check
owner_tin_check.value: ("owner"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("owner"."tin_index" is null) and ("owner"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("owner"."tin_masked" is null)

lease_break_check.name: lease_break_check
lease_break_check.value: ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_party" is null) and ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_notice_days" is null) and ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_credit_unused_days" is null) and ("lease"."break_party" is null or "lease"."break_party" in ('tenant', 'landlord', 'either'))

lease_template_version_review_check.name: lease_template_version_review_check
lease_template_version_review_check.value: ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_at" is null) = ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_by" is null) and ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_at" is null) = ("lease_template_version"."counsel_review_note" is null)

tenant_id_number_check.name: tenant_id_number_check
tenant_id_number_check.value: ("tenant"."id_type" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) and ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_index" is null) and ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_masked" is null)

tenant_tin_check.name: tenant_tin_check
tenant_tin_check.value: ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."tin_index" is null) and ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."tin_masked" is null) and ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null or "tenant"."kind" = 'company')

tenant_company_fields_check.name: tenant_company_fields_check
tenant_company_fields_check.value: "tenant"."kind" = 'company' or ("tenant"."registration_number" is null and "tenant"."business_type" is null and "tenant"."legal_name" is null)

secure_link_signer_check.name: secure_link_signer_check
secure_link_signer_check.value: "secure_link"."purpose" not in ('sign', 'signed_copy') or "secure_link"."signer_id" is not null

secure_link_pay_check.name: secure_link_pay_check
secure_link_pay_check.value: ("secure_link"."purpose" = 'pay') = ("secure_link"."invoice_id" is not null) and ("secure_link"."purpose" = 'receipt') = ("secure_link"."receipt_id" is not null)

signature_method_fields_check.name: signature_method_fields_check
signature_method_fields_check.value: ("signature"."method" = 'typed' and "signature"."typed_name" is not null) or ("signature"."method" = 'drawn' and "signature"."drawing_document_id" is not null)

signer_subject_check.name: signer_subject_check
signer_subject_check.value: "signer"."subject_type" in ('tenant', 'tenant_contact', 'staff', 'other') and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'tenant_contact' or "signer"."tenant_contact_id" is not null) and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'staff' or "signer"."staff_person_id" is not null) and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'tenant' or "signer"."tenant_id" is not null)

signer_contact_check.name: signer_contact_check
signer_contact_check.value: "signer"."phone" is not null or "signer"."email" is not null

signing_request_lease_check.name: signing_request_lease_check
signing_request_lease_check.value: "signing_request"."subject_type" <> 'lease' or ("signing_request"."lease_id" is not null and "signing_request"."tenant_id" is not null)

signing_request_document_check.name: signing_request_document_check
signing_request_document_check.value: "signing_request"."status" in ('preparing', 'cancelled') or ("signing_request"."document_id" is not null and "signing_request"."document_sha256" is not null)

signing_request_final_check.name: signing_request_final_check
signing_request_final_check.value: "signing_request"."status" <> 'completed' or ("signing_request"."final_document_id" is not null and "signing_request"."final_sha256" is not null and "signing_request"."completed_at" is not null)

message_recipient_check.name: message_recipient_check
message_recipient_check.value: "message"."recipient_type" in ('tenant', 'tenant_contact', 'staff', 'signer', 'owner') and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'tenant' or "message"."tenant_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'tenant_contact' or "message"."tenant_contact_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'staff' or "message"."staff_person_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'signer' or "message"."signer_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'owner' or "message"."owner_id" is not null)

message_link_check.name: message_link_check
message_link_check.value: ("message"."link_purpose" is null or "message"."link_purpose" in ('sign', 'signed_copy', 'id_capture', 'pay', 'receipt')) and ("message"."link_purpose" is null) = ("message"."link_target_id" is null)

message_event_sent_check.name: message_event_sent_check
message_event_sent_check.value: "message_event"."status" <> 'sent' or ("message_event"."channel" is not null and "message_event"."provider" is not null and "message_event"."provider_message_id" is not null)

message_event_cost_check.name: message_event_cost_check
message_event_cost_check.value: ("message_event"."cost_minor" is null) = ("message_event"."currency" is null) and ("message_event"."cost_minor" is null or "message_event"."cost_minor" >= 0)

journal_line_unit_check.name: journal_line_unit_check
journal_line_unit_check.value: "journal_line"."unit_id" is null or "journal_line"."property_id" is not null

cash_record_cheque_check.name: cash_record_cheque_check
cash_record_cheque_check.value: "cash_record"."method" = 'cheque' or ("cash_record"."cheque_number" is null and "cash_record"."cheque_bank" is null)

direct_receipt_lease_check.name: direct_receipt_lease_check
direct_receipt_lease_check.value: ("direct_receipt"."lease_id" is null) = ("direct_receipt"."property_id" is null) and ("direct_receipt"."lease_id" is null) = ("direct_receipt"."tenant_id" is null) and ("direct_receipt"."lease_id" is null) = ("direct_receipt"."unit_id" is null)

early_termination_paid_check.name: early_termination_paid_check
early_termination_paid_check.value:
("early_termination"."status" = 'refund_paid') = ("early_termination"."paid_entry_id" is not null)
          and ("early_termination"."paid_entry_id" is null or ("early_termination"."paid_on" is not null and "early_termination"."paid_from" in ('owner_account', 'agency_account')
               and "early_termination"."paid_reference" is not null and "early_termination"."proof_document_id" is not null))

invoice_period_check.name: invoice_period_check
invoice_period_check.value: ("invoice"."period_from" is null) = ("invoice"."period_to" is null) and ("invoice"."period_to" is null or "invoice"."period_to" >= "invoice"."period_from")

invoice_line_tax_check.name: invoice_line_tax_check
invoice_line_tax_check.value: ("invoice_line"."kind" in ('vat', 'nhil', 'getfund')) = ("invoice_line"."base_line_id" is not null) and ("invoice_line"."kind" in ('vat', 'nhil', 'getfund')) = ("invoice_line"."rate_bps" is not null)

invoice_line_period_check.name: invoice_line_period_check
invoice_line_period_check.value: ("invoice_line"."kind" in ('rent', 'service_charge')) = ("invoice_line"."charge_period_id" is not null) and ("invoice_line"."charge_period_id" is null) = ("invoice_line"."period_start" is null) and ("invoice_line"."period_start" is null) = ("invoice_line"."period_end" is null)

payment_lease_check.name: payment_lease_check
payment_lease_check.value: ("payment"."lease_id" is null) = ("payment"."property_id" is null) and ("payment"."lease_id" is null) = ("payment"."tenant_id" is null) and ("payment"."lease_id" is null) = ("payment"."unit_id" is null)

payment_advance_flag_check.name: payment_advance_flag_check
payment_advance_flag_check.value:
(not "payment_advance"."flagged" or ("payment_advance"."over_limit" and "payment_advance"."policy" <> 'off'))
          and (not "payment_advance"."over_limit" or "payment_advance"."limit_months" is not null)

payment_intent_momo_check.name: payment_intent_momo_check
payment_intent_momo_check.value: ("payment_intent"."method" = 'momo') = ("payment_intent"."momo_network" is not null) and ("payment_intent"."method" = 'momo') = ("payment_intent"."payer_phone_encrypted" is not null)

settlement_account_usable_check.name: settlement_account_usable_check
settlement_account_usable_check.value: "settlement_account"."status" in ('awaiting_approval', 'rejected') or ("settlement_account"."approved_at" is not null and "settlement_account"."usable_from" is not null)

rent_tax_item_sign_check.name: rent_tax_item_sign_check
rent_tax_item_sign_check.value:
case when "rent_tax_item"."kind" in ('reversal', 'withholding_offset')
            then "rent_tax_item"."tax_minor" <= 0 and "rent_tax_item"."base_minor" <= 0 and "rent_tax_item"."reverses_item_id" is not null and "rent_tax_item"."due_date" is null
            else "rent_tax_item"."tax_minor" >= 0 and "rent_tax_item"."base_minor" >= 0 and "rent_tax_item"."reverses_item_id" is null and "rent_tax_item"."due_date" is not null end

rent_tax_item_source_check.name: rent_tax_item_source_check
rent_tax_item_source_check.value:
("rent_tax_item"."kind" in ('withholding', 'withholding_offset')) = ("rent_tax_item"."withholding_id" is not null)
          and ("rent_tax_item"."kind" not in ('receipt', 'reversal') or "rent_tax_item"."payment_id" is not null)

withholding_certificate_two_people_check.name: withholding_certificate_two_people_check
withholding_certificate_two_people_check.value: "withholding_certificate"."decided_by" is null or "withholding_certificate"."decided_by" <> "withholding_certificate"."uploaded_by" or "withholding_certificate"."self_confirm_request_id" is not null

withholding_certificate_posted_check.name: withholding_certificate_posted_check
withholding_certificate_posted_check.value:
("withholding_certificate"."status" = 'confirmed') = ("withholding_certificate"."entry_id" is not null)
          and ("withholding_certificate"."status" = 'confirmed') = ("withholding_certificate"."debit_account" is not null)
          and ("withholding_certificate"."debit_account" is null or "withholding_certificate"."debit_account" in ('2200', '1160'))
